safe_cex_store::model_patch::PatchSource.reason: Reviewed model_patch.rs: the Map impl hands each existing JSON entry to the caller's visitor unchanged as PatchValueRef::Json(&value), in map order, and stops at the first visitor error. It constructs no typed value; field decoding happens in the store patch applicator that consumes the visitor, which keeps its own coverage.

safe_cex_transport::signing::RemoteSigne.reason: Reviewed signing.rs: the default ignores its typed HttpSigningRequest and returns TransportError::Host refusing native query signing. It reads no raw input and produces no decoded value; implementors that override it are inventoried at their own impls.

safe_cex_venue_binance::private_classes:.reason: Reviewed private_classes.rs: the default sends the outgoing payload string through send, then passes the same text to diagnostic_send. It serializes nothing and decodes nothing; the String is outbound wire text, not raw input to a decoder.

safe_cex_venue_blofin::exchange::BlofinP.reason: Reviewed exchange.rs: listen_book on the Rc<BlofinPublicWebsocket<H>> receiver forwards the symbol and callback to BlofinPublicWebsocket::listen_order_book unchanged. Book message decoding belongs to that websocket owner; this impl adds no parsing.

safe_cex_venue_coinbase::portfolios_bala.reason: Reviewed portfolios_balances.rs: the Rc<H> impl forwards every PortfolioHost method to (**self) unchanged, so a retained class host is the same capability rather than a copy. Decoding of PortfolioReply belongs to the concrete H implementation, not this forwarding receiver.

safe_cex_exchange::exchange::Exchange::f.reason: Reviewed the default fetch_option_expiries body: it ignores its underlying String, constructs options_unsupported(self.name(), "Option expiries"), and returns that venue-named error without parsing input or constructing an expiry.
